result:
I added `GET /api/v1/items/stats`. I didn't run the tests, the app or the linter, so it is untested.

The endpoint returns `{"count": n, "newest_title": str | null}`. Regular users get the count and newest title for their own items. Superusers get them across all items. "Newest" means latest `created_at`, with `id` as a tie-break.

- **`backend/app/models.py`**: new `ItemsStats` response schema.
- **`backend/app/crud.py`**: new `get_item_stats(*, session, owner_id=None)`. It holds the queries, so the route never touches the session, as the `db-access-in-crud` rule requires.
- **`backend/app/api/routes/items.py`**: new `read_item_stats` route. It sits before `/{id}`, so "stats" isn't parsed as an item id.

I haven't regenerated the frontend client. `docs/api.md` asks for that after endpoint changes, so run `bash scripts/generate-client.sh` before merging. I also haven't run `ruff format`, so the new code may need formatting.
